nom: SUNDAY RILEY Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Essence

avis.texte: I keep this wonder spritzer in my mini fridge and use it after I wash my face. Its a quick morning refresher for my skin, makes it feel clean, tight, and is gentle enough for daily use. I love using it on no makeup days since it gives my skin a little glow boost!

Yep! That is it, just water with pink food coloring for a nice touch! That is what you're spending your hard earned 48 bucks on! I'm so pissed that I spent that much on this. I truly do love Sunday Riley products and I can vouch for her other products that are great and works great too BUT this, I can't say that whatsoever, even if they paid me to. Please don't waste your money on this. There are so many other brands/products that works great.

I've used this product for a while now and love it BUT I don't know if they changed their spray nozzle or if I was just unlucky enough to get a broken one but it's awful. It doesn't spray evenly like it has in the past and I end up with it all over everything but my face. It's not cheap so I'd expect a better quality spray nozzle. Super disappointed. I have recommended this product to friends in the past but now I hesitate to.
has been ongoing repurchase. its cute and easy to use during the day

I love Sunday Riley skincare, and I bought the pink firming essence last year and I've been using it since Decemeber consistently and I'm blown away!! My skin is sensitive/combination and since ive been using this product my skin's texture, firmness, and overall radiance has improved significantly!! I also wear this under makeup and my base has never looked better. RUN don't walk!! Will forever repurchase.

avis.titre: Early evaluation is yes I like this product
avis.texte: Product seems to be hydrating my skin. It is quickly absorbed leaving no trace of oils
I had high hopes for this product based on the reviews. But, after using it for over a month, I didn't find any results.
This is awesome I use it before and after makeup and during the day just to freshen up my face I feel the tightening on my face immediately my skin has never looked better ...I highly recommend

avis.titre: Would buy again if on sale
avis.texte: Very pleased with Pink Drink product but small amount for the price. Absorbs quickly leaving a smooth and comfortable surface.

avis.titre: Sunday Riley Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Essence
avis.texte: I love this Essence Pink Drink. It makes my skin feel great before I add anything else to my skin. This is a great product and I love it so much. It makes me feel younger and younger each day.
There is an irritant(s) in this product for my skin and I feel it has a high amount of alcohol. Very dehydrating!
Not good for people who tend to break out in response to products.
Don't waste your money! I got this and was told how great it was and I used it and it did ABSOULTELY NOTHING!! It is $$$ for pink water and ur just buying the name of the brand.

I absolutely love this product. I apply after i was my face, whike its still a little wet. It's refreshing and provides a nice amount of moisture. During the day I follow with snail mucine, Tula primer, some bronzer and blush for a natural look. Im 48 snd i get compliments on my skin. My one wish is that the product would be a bit bigger for the price

avis.titre: This is my 5th re-purchase of this product
avis.texte: I love all Sunday Riley skin care and this product is so moisturizing and refreshing. I apply it after my Vitamin C serum and Hyaluronic acid serum and then move on to the rest of my daily skin care routine and makeup.

I really wish they would make refills for this. It works amazing but the bottle is very small, I cannot imagine my skin care routine without this product. It's just a very nice glass bottle, that could be refilled over and over. I always have it on hand but I have all these nice bottles .. Refills and possibly make a bigger size??

I have been using this for 2 weeks now and kit only does my skin feel so smooth and hydrated all day, I'm getting compliments which I never do. It feels so refreshing and not perfumy or irritating, just clean and fresh. Feels smooth all day. Highly recommend

I use the sunday riley CEO glow and A+ retinol religiously so I figured this addition would be worth it. NOPE! This doesn't do anything different than my affordable mario badescu facial sprays and was gone in 2 weeks with 2x daily use. Plus, the mario badescu ones actually smell good! I will never buy this pink drink again and thoroughly regret spending so much on it

I bought this while it was sale for the beauty sale. it's feels great. doesn't really do anything though. doesn't have a smell. I use it mostly in the mornings after rinsing my face. I have sensitive, reactive skin and rosacea. didn't make break out.

I have just discovered Sunday Riley and the first product I used was the Good Genes,love. The second was the CEO oil, like. The third was this Pink Drink, hate. Before you get upset let me explain. I am in my mid 60's and have always had dry sensitive skin. I'm not sure why this is so bad for my face but first I tried spraying it and it comes out strong and hits way off center so next I tried it by spraying in my hands and patting on my face but it just instantly soaks in and feels as if it just sucked out all my moisture with a vacuum. I thought I might need a little more but NO, same thing. I haven't ever had a reaction like this before. I was hoping it would work but by far the worst and weirdest reaction I have ever experienced. I will just continue to use my Avene water spray that doubles as my moisturizer. Hope your skin has a better outcome.

avis.titre: I love using the Pink Drink Essence spray
avis.texte: I love spritzing a little Pink Drink on my face in both my morning & evening skincare routine. It hydrates and firms my skin. I love using it as part of my morning routine before makeup. I'm enjoying all the Sunday Riley products!

I just bought this and used it for the first time. My skin feels refreshing and soft just from this spray! I didnt even put moisturizer on. It doesnt smell like anything so im not sure why some reviewers said it smells good. Im happy with this purchase and curious to see if it changes my 39 yr old skin

I didn't see any results with this product on my skin, maybe it's just not right for my skin right now. I feel like it would benefit someone who is older and has dry skin. I definitely did not enjoy the smell (smells like an alcoholic beverage) every time I sprayed it on I would sneeze.
I bought this during the 50% off event. It makes your face very soft. I use day and night after washing my face. It's too early to tell if it does anything for wrinkles but I will update if it does.

avis.titre: It's not my favorite Sunday Riley product
avis.texte: I haven't noticed this product being any more moisturizing or plumping than other essences than I have purchased (for less even). What am I missing? Granted I am only using 1-1 1/2 sprays because of the price but it seems like I'd notice something?
Love this spray smells amazing, clean ingredients and my face feels amazing after. Skin looks hydrated.
I spray this on my face after cleansing, morning and night. It is so refreshing and leaves my face feeling so soft and perky!!!
I was sceptical about this product before using. But now i am hooked! Makes my face feel smooth and hydrated! Refreshing!
a nice cooled feeling to my skin. I have very dry skin and this just plumps it up for my next step. It's 100% worth the hype!! ♡
I received a full size gift with purchase. I like the product, but would not repurchase for the price
I got this with one of my kits and I love it. But…. It's too expensive for the size. I had to replace with a more affordable product. Bottle is small
I absolutely love this stuff. It makes my skin feel so fresh and plumped up.

Great product for me. I am dealing with wrinkles AND blemishes now, so I really appreciate that this is a product that targets wrinkles and is not full of oils and butters. I would love if more brands, including this one, would consider refills or some other way to minimize my having to throw out the pump each time I use up a bottle. I do appreciate that this is a glass bottle so it's easily recycled, so didn't take a star off for the lack of refill option. I'll continue to buy it for sure.

I bought this on a whim not really knowing what it would do. Wow! It made an immediate difference in the lines and wrinkles in my face, particularly around my mouth. My husband kept commenting that my wrinkles were going away. I thought he was crazy until I did a side by side. I am very happy with this impulse purchase!
I was hesistant to buy this. Not exactly sure what it did. Now that I have it I won't go without it. It makes your skin feel good and refreshed. I really like it.
I buy it religiously. Nothing bad to report. Good results through and through.

Excellent product - love it! On my 3rd bottle (at least). Knocked off one star off because the packaging is ridiculously small. Especially for the price. Sunday Riley, please make this in a bigger / value size. It would be better for the planet! Thank you! :)
This product is amazing I keep mine in the refrigerator for a great hot afternoon cool pick up!

Love the product, but the pump seemed different on this order. Instead of doing a nice spray, it would very directly spray me in the eyes, which makes using it unpleasant. I am not sure if this makes much of a difference on my skin, but I use it every morning as a refreshing wake up, and for that, I love it. I do wish the price point was a little more affordable.
I LOVE THIS. I used a different one and it did NOTHING for me. But, guys let me tell you, the Pink Drink is the best facial essence I have used and 100/10.
Added this to the routine morning and night. It soaks right in immediately and I feel like it makes the serums work even better.
I bought this toner a few weeks ago and absolutely love it! It feels refreshing when sprayed on my skin, and I can't imagine not using it as part of my daily routine.
use after cleanser every night, feel skin tighten almost immediately
Best product ever, the only one you can watch the magic happen in the mirror . If you only get one product to try , this is the one to get.
It's a great prep prior to applying serum & moisturizing. So refreshing too.
So happy with the results I get from Sunday Riley products. Pink Drink and Face Oils.

I reviewed this in an Ipsy box who knows how long ago. I'm incredibly bad at opening them when they come in. But I finally opened it and sorted things out to try tonight in my skin care routine. I have psoriatic arthritis abs have patches on my face. As such my skin is fairly dry. I started with my cleanser and use the Pink Drink right afterward. I followed with vitamin c serum, illuminating serum, snail muscin and my moisturize followed by a warm massage to let it settle in and a cold massage to close my pores again. . I've been doing the other steps for about a month but this pink drink stuff is legit. Immediately afterwards my skin was softer, more hydrated, no patches of psoriasis and not red anymore. I am amazed. It's been about 6 hours and I still feel hydrated. It's going to become a vital step in my skin care routine and it's already healing my damaged skin. Definitely buy this!

avis.titre: I do not recommend this product
avis.texte: I hated the smell of this product, waste of money to even try, and broke my skin into thousands of itchy bumps. Ruined my skin for the worst right after I was getting to a great point in my skin care. TERRIBLE
I like how this feels. I like that it lets my other serums and moisturizers soak in better and preps the skin.
Been using Sunday Riley since last Christmas..received the gift pack

I absolutely love pink drink. I usually use it in the summer but it's good for year round use It helps with dry skin and feels wonderful. Especially on hot days or if you live in a state that's warmer than Michigan. Whenever I have the extra money, I make sure to get my pink drink. It's totally worth it and actually works to improve your skin.
EXCELLENT. I use this after cleansing, before applying the other serums and moisturizers. Love the smell, love the idea of it, great product.
I love the product. It is great on my skin. I certainly recommend.
This makes my face feel so good and I can see that my complexion is smoother and more even toned.

New to the Sunday Riley brand. Started using the 15% Vitamin C serum at the recommendation of a favorite online Dermatologist. Then began looking at additional product and I love a good essence mist. I fell hard for this one. There is a tingle when first sprayed on my face which is pleasant and makes the adventure seem effective.

I'm disappointed. The purchase came with an large sample in A+ and also auto correct. But they were both completely dry. I use those sample for weeks normally. It's actually an incentive to purchase More. But I've never had this issue before where the deluxe samples are empty 😟 can you help me fix this error?
This is my favorite product you feel a slight tingle when u spritz it on and you see immediate results skin looks tighter and feels it too
Pink Drink seems to firm my 70 year old face. A friend, who uses Sunday Riley products, gifted this. I reordered.
Pink Drink is probably one of favorite steps in my skincare routine. It's refreshing and I feel like I'm really setting my skin up for the rest of my routine.

avis.titre: Sets the "tone" for my morning and evening routine
avis.texte: I use this refreshing face spray most definitely before all of my products to follow. It just helps my skin to absorb them all. I'm 58 years old and Sunday Riley skincare is terrific
Love this. Seems to tighten firm, decrease appearance fine lines and moisturizes
Love, love, LOVE this product! Very refreshing and it helped smooth out some problem areas on my face. I spray it in my hands and gently dab on. Couldn't wait to reorder.
I prefer to spray in my palm and then put on my face and neck. The fragrance is mild and it dries quickly which to me is important to me.

Enjoy using this product between cleansing and moisturizing. Feels refreshing and seems to help balance out redness. No noticeable difference on firming, but I still like it. Unsure whether I'll repurchase, but I'll continue using the rest of what I have.

I have dry sensitive skin and once I spray it on my face my skin started to burn.. My face broke out . . Once I sprayed it I hated the smell it has too much scent it smelled like fragrance and this product has alcohol in it which my sensitive skin can't stand !
I don't even know what this does… but I absolutely love this spray. Pores look smaller. Smoother skin. Perfect base before my serum and moisturizer.

I love this stuff. I stopped using for a few weeks. My face didn't like that at all. Within a few days of starting the routine back up my face has cleared right up. I love it. I would recommend this to anyone to at least try. I started with the downtown abbey kit. And decided what products my face liked and needed. Ive been using Sunday Riley for over 2 months and have seen a dramatic improvement.
Even though I read many reviews about this spray, I took my chance to go with it. Makeup setting sprays never work on me. I know this is not a setting spray, but keeps my makeup on throughout the day

avis.titre: 100% now a part of my daily skin care
avis.texte: Want that plump youthful feel..you have to get this!! It's soooo amazing!!!!!
Love this elixir!!! Fabulous for smoothing out my skin and firming as well.
I am in love with this product. Feels so good on my skin and makes my skin glow and smells great.

This has changed the game for me completely. It has cleared up my skin, softened it, and decreased wrinkles. A little pricey but completely worth it. I use it every morning and night after cleansing. It gives a nice tingle for a minute or so and has a nice clean scent that isn't overwhelming. The results speak for themselves and you notice a difference in the first couple of uses.

As so many others have said, this is awesome for your skin but, man, is it expensive for how quickly you can go thru it. I have found that if you spray just 2 spritz on your hands & then press it into your skin (like a traditional essence) the product lasts a lot longer than spraying it directly onto your face. Just a tip!
This is an amazing primer to Good Genes. It helps smooth the skin. I love the ingredients and believe the peptides are a game changer.
Would rate 5 stars but is a little pricy considering the ounces. Other than that I'm in love!

I purchased this with some birthday money because my skin gets dry and I wanted something to refresh, rejuvenate it during the day. My friend recommended it and so I purchased it. The product not only smells good but is helping your skin at the same time.

Love what this does for my face! Makes it soft and hydrated while toning and smoothing. But it doesn't last! The product itself is so small for the price and lasts me about two weeks if that. I use in the morning and night after cleansing and it works great, but I can't help but notice how fast it goes. I'm definitely looking for a dupe.

Tried this on a whim and so happy I did. My face has never felt better. I use it twice daily immediately after cleansing. My skin feels hydrated, firm and bright. It also feels like its helping to control my acne because I'm normally blemish prone and I haven't had a single breakout since incorporating this in to my routine. Highly recommended.

I received a sample size of Pink Drink Firming Resurfacing Essence with the Sunday Riley "Wake Up With Me" kit. It lives up to its name! It's easy to spritz on clean dry skin, and leaves my face feeling smooth and ready to apply any other products. I have sensitive skin and have had NO problems with this product - my face feels better every time I use it. I'm surprised and pleased with the improvements I'm seeing in my skin, and I've already invested in a full sized bottle.
Pink Drink!! I spray it on in the morning after I've cleaned my face. It feels awesome, Firming, and leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. I highly recommend!
I bought this after a recommendation from a friend and it's everything she said it was and more. It's refreshing, rejuvenating and moisturizing. It's definitely a permanent part of my routine now.
I love this so much! It's definitely a favorite in my routine and I will buy more.

To be fair, I am a SR fanatic… I use literally almost every one of their products. If they bottled up pee and put it in a pretty bottle I'd probably pay $100 for it. I don't know if my skin absolutely NEEDS this but I love this essence. It's one of the very few that doesn't make my face feel super tight after application and it def makes your skin super smooth before putting additional products on.
Love this product! Love how it makes my skin look after a spritz!

I originally bought this as part of my evening routine, but I use it at least twice a day now. It helps prep my skin for the rest of my skincare after I wash my face; I find my products go on more evenly after I use this. Plus - it's super refreshing.
I was skeptical about an essence at first but this has become a staple.
I do use am and pm on clean skin prior to anything else. Very nice results.

I just found Sunday Riley in my life and I absolutely love it. I have the entire line of the day and night products. I never leave reviews but I felt I must with these products. I don't know anyone that has used these products and is unsure of how amazing these are! Must buy ladies and I didn't get paid to write this.

I really enjoy Sunday Rileys skin regimen. I had a sample of the Pink Drink and got hooked. It feels so good to spray on a fresh face before my Good Genes. These are truly the BEST products I have ever tried. I have spent so much money on cheap products. These are worth the money and last a long time because you only need a tiny bit. Definitely keeping as my regular routine.

Absolutely love this! I guess it is like a toner, but feels so much better than any I have used before. It smells good too! SR is a little pricey for me but I ordered a second bottle so I wouldn't run out

I've had Pink Drink for a couple of weeks now and I can see and feel the difference in my skin already. I use and love a lot of Sunday Riley products but this one has my skin feeling softer and smoother.
I love Pink drink. It's firming my skin and doing all it claims to do. Love it

avis.titre: Not a lot of product for price point
avis.texte: I really love the mister and the way the product feels but I'm worried with using it everyday it's going to not end up being worth it for the money. I'm on the fence if I would buy another bottle, maybe if it was on sale again. I also feel like it's a good light essence for this florida girl. I apply after toner and before serums
Preordered when first launched and have not been without since. SR has the best products that deliver actual results!
It definitely works! I saw firmer, brighter looking skin. It has a great mist too. Unfortunately it did break me out as well.
Excellent feeling on the skin. Seems to impart nutrients as stated.
Simple- I love it! Easy to put peptides into my skin and actually see an improvement in tightening!
I use it as a toner with a cotton swab after washing my face helps take any left over make up off
I love this product! It smells great and gives my skin that comfort after a deep exfoliating! Makes my face look glowing, definitely the holy grail of skin care regimen!

avis.titre: Love this if you're okay with spending the $$
avis.texte: I absolutely love this literally everything about it ..smells amazing so cute and is called the "pink drink". It helps my skin absorb serums and moisturizer quickly and leaves my face feeling extremely refreshed. The only reason I gave 4 stars is because of the price it's a spray so it's going to go buy fast .. and for $48 it's a little pricey.
Love it! I can totally tell a difference when i use it consistently in my skin care routine!
I live in Montana, we have no humidity to speak of. I use Pink Drink out of the shower, CEO Glow after drying my hair and Tidal before I head out the door. Winter I trade tidal for Ice. Love it all.

absolutely love this. not only do i love all sunday riley products this one is well worth the money. super refreshing and calming. i have extremely sensitive skin and thus product has made such a difference
Been using this on my face as the first thing after cleansing. Love the way it preps my skin for my moIsturizer and then SPF lotion
So refreshing to use. My skin loves it along with my other Sunday Riley must-haves.
